name: Four Seasons Hotel Casablanca
insider_take: Morocco's economic capital meets timeless luxury in this stunning oceanfront sanctuary where Atlantic breezes carry the scent of orange blossoms through elegantly appointed spaces.
whats_special: This is Casablanca's first and only Five-Star hotel, featuring the city's largest outdoor pool and exclusive beach access along the Corniche. The property seamlessly blends contemporary Moroccan design with French colonial influences, while offering unobstructed Atlantic Ocean views from every guest room.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Bleu restaurant's terrace - you'll witness the legendary Casablanca sunset that inspired countless films, while enjoying Mediterranean cuisine with Moroccan touches just steps from where "Casablanca" scenes were imagined.
dont_miss: The Hassan II Mosque (10 minutes away) - one of the world's largest mosques with its minaret soaring 690 feet above the Atlantic. Its glass floor offers views of the ocean below, and it's one of the few mosques in Morocco open to non-Muslim visitors for guided tours.
pros: Prime oceanfront location with stunning Atlantic Ocean views
Signature Four Seasons luxury service and attention to detail
Modern sophisticated design blending Moroccan heritage with contemporary elegance
cons: Urban beachfront setting rather than secluded resort atmosphere
